scenarios.name: initial_greeting
expected_behaviors: Greets user in a friendly manner

scenarios.name: vibe_preferences_gathering

conversation.content: I want to start my trip interview
Great! Let's understand your preferences. What kind of vibe are you looking for?
I prefer adventurous experiences and local secrets over tourist spots

expected_behaviors: Remembers adventurous and local secrets preference

scenarios.name: location_and_duration_gathering
scenarios.description: Test gathering location, radius, and duration preferences

conversation.content: I'm in San Francisco and have a weekend available

expected_behaviors: Asks about preferred radius or distance for travel

scenarios.name: time_awareness_gathering
scenarios.description: Test gathering current time and time-based preferences

conversation.content: It's currently 3 PM on a Saturday

expected_behaviors: May ask about evening vs daytime preferences

scenarios.name: conversation_pacing
scenarios.description: Test that agent asks one or two questions at a time

conversation.content: Tell me what you need to know

expected_behaviors: Doesn't overwhelm with too many questions

scenarios.name: completion_handoff
scenarios.description: Test proper completion and handoff back to game master

conversation.content: I prefer adventurous local secrets in San Francisco within 20 miles for a weekend trip, and it's currently 2 PM

expected_behaviors: Recognizes all key information has been gathered
Indicates transfer back to game master

scenarios.name: incomplete_information_handling
scenarios.description: Test handling of vague or incomplete responses
